::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/webhook_endpoints"}
#docs
## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | `string` | no | Where to POST. |
| `business` | `string` | no | Scope delivery to one business (biz_… id). Omit/null = all of the org’s events IN THIS ENDPOINT’S PARTITION. |
| `livemode` | `string` | no | The endpoint's test/live partition. Resolved when omitted: from `business` if scoped, else from the calling key's mode. Required (400 if omitted) only for an org-wide endpoint created with a full-access key. Rejected (400) if it contradicts `business`. One of `test`, `live`. |
| `event_types` | `array of string` | no | The event types this endpoint receives. Omit or null = every type, including types added later. Each entry must be a type from the event reference (400 otherwise). |
| `description` | `string` | no | The webhook endpoint's description. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `id` | `string` | The webhook endpoint's id (whe_…). |
| `url` | `string` | The URL that receives the webhooks. |
| `business` | `string` | Business scope; null = receives all of the org’s events in this endpoint’s partition. |
| `livemode` | `string` | The endpoint's partition. An endpoint only ever receives events from businesses in its own partition; org-level events (no business) reach both. Immutable. One of `test`, `live`. |
| `signing_secret` | `string` | Returned once at creation; verify deliveries with HMAC-SHA256. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | Whether the endpoint receives webhooks. |
| `event_types` | `array of string` | The event types this endpoint receives; null = every type. |
| `description` | `string` | The webhook endpoint's description. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the webhook endpoint was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Created |
| `400` | Invalid body, or an unknown event type |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/webhook_endpoints" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "url": "https://example.com/webhooks/billing",
    "description": "Order fulfilment"
  }'
```
